Install basecamp-cli on Omarchy

basecamp-cli is Basecamp's official command-line client, letting you list and manage projects, to-dos, cards, and messages, post updates, and search across your Basecamp account from a terminal. It authenticates via OAuth 2.1 in the browser on first login and then handles token refresh automatically, and it also ships plugins/MCP support so AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot can act on your Basecamp account directly.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add basecamp-cli
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.20.0-1:
    pacman -Qi basecamp-cli

Open and use basecamp-cli

basecamp-cli has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql basecamp-cli | grep /usr/bin/

basecamp-cli requirements and compatibility

  • a Basecamp account
  • a Basecamp subscription for the underlying project-management service
  • network access, since it talks to Basecamp's API

Pricing and license

Free to use (the CLI is free; it requires a Basecamp account, and Basecamp itself is a paid product). License: MIT.

Uninstall basecamp-cli

omarchy pkg drop basecamp-cli

Frequently asked questions

How do I install basecamp-cli on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add basecamp-cli. The download is 16.3 MB and it takes 49.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is basecamp-cli free?

Free to use (the CLI is free; it requires a Basecamp account, and Basecamp itself is a paid product). The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall basecamp-cli?

Run omarchy pkg drop basecamp-cli. It removes the package from your system.

What does basecamp-cli depend on?

basecamp-cli declares no dependencies in the Omarchy package database.

Is basecamp-cli a desktop app?

No. basecamp-cli has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is basecamp-cli in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as basecamp-cli (version 0.20.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. 37signals makes it. Project site: https://github.com/basecamp/basecamp-cli.
